postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= |D(n)| and 1 <= bi <= |D(n)| and ai != bi for ai, bi in queries)
postconditions.description: Each query specifies two distinct vertices within the graph D(n).

postconditions.expression: all(output_length(query) == shortest_path_length(D(n), ai, bi) for query in queries)
postconditions.description: For each query, the output is the length of the shortest path between the specified vertices ai and bi in the graph D(n).
